text: You just lost your tablet you just received and are in a bad mood. You want to know the tracking number of the order, and if the agent can help you refund or reorder the tablet. (You know it's a long shot, but you want to try). If not, cancel the charger you just bought, because it goes with the tablet... Also cancel the boot and kettle, and return the sneaker.
zh: 你刚收到的平板电脑丢了，心情很不好。你想知道订单的追踪号，并且想知道客服能否帮你退款或重新订购平板电脑。（你知道希望渺茫，但想试试）。如果不行，取消你刚买的充电器，因为它和平板电脑是一套……也取消靴子和水壶，把运动鞋退货。(#W1234567, 平板电脑, #P7890123, 充电器, #P4567890, 靴子, #P1234567, 运动鞋)
